item.createsprings.portative_steam_engin: A small _Steam Engine_ capable of _charging_ tools, lighting the way, and also _warming_ and _accelerating_ players
Allows for a _Steam Dash_ when the _pressure_ level is above _70_, Also reduces the _pressure_
item.createsprings.broken_portative_stea: _mechanism_ that has been subjected to _improper use_, despite the damage, _can be repaired_
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.sum: Can _program_ some tools by executing _simple instructions_ in cycle, can hold a _small amount_ of commands
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.beh: if punchcard is in a tool and it is _waiting for activation_, the next _instruction_ will be executed _instantly_
item.createsprings.sus_package.tooltip.s: This package when _dropped_ from a height or _destroyed_, releases a _spring_ that bounces off _blocks_ or _entities_
item.createsprings.hat.tooltip.summary: A _hat_. can be _dyed_ or _placed_ on the ground and also can store _1 stack_ , if engineer _goggles_ are inside it will function as engineer _goggles_
item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.s: A Base for _spring-powered_ tools, can hold up to _2 springs_, to transform it into a spring tool place a _modifier_ inside
item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.c: When a spring is _stacked_ on the tool
A _spring-powered_ drill, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Mining _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.su: A _spring-powered_ saw, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Harvesting _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.co: R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.be: Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
A _spring-powered_ shovel, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Harvesting _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.su: A _portable_ spring-powered _Fan_, Can hold up to _2 springs_, pushes entities _to_ or _from_ the player, direction changes when _Shift_ is pressed, Works on _elytra_
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.co: R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.be: Instantly releases the spring _charge_ in the tool, converting it to _extreme_ speed
item.createsprings.spring_launcher.toolt: A _powerful_ weapon that can _fire springs_ or _spring alloy blocks_, scope can be added by _placing a spyglass_ inside
R-click with springs in the launcher
releases a _spring_ that bounces off _blocks_ or _entities_
R-click with a spring and a spring alloy block in the launcher
fires a spring alloy block that _explodes_ on _landing_
item.createsprings.explosion_chamber.too: R-click with a _spring_ and _fuel_ in the chamber
block.createsprings.spring.tooltip.behav: если игрок _держит_ пружину то она _преобразовывает_ часть урона в _заряд_ тем самым _смягчая_ посадку
Невероятно _упругий_ материал, устойчив к _взрывам_, имеет низкую температуру плавления
createsprings.pse.tooltip.5: increasing the speed of spring tools
createsprings.pse.tooltip.overdrive: when _overdrive_ is turned on _PSE_ will work with maximum speed in any mode, but _pressure_ in engine will constantley _rise_, When _pressure_ hits _100_ engine _explodes_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.overdrive2: you will be able to do _steam dash_ when pressure is more than 70 to lower pressure but it is a _temporary measure_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.water: when there is _no water_ in the engine, _PSE_ will try find _water bucket_ in the _inventory_ if it finds _water bucket_ inner tank will be _restored_ and water bucket _wouldn't be spent_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.fuel: a slot for _fuel_, you can put any _furnace fuel_ in that slot
